games.title: Unreal Championship 2: The Liandri Conflict
games.gameFiles: a UC2 game folder made from your copy of the game (System with its 17 script packages and inis, Maps, Textures, Sounds and the rest)
settingsNotes: A game folder started before this release was extracted into it keeps the Xbox save manager in Avaris.ini, and the game then exits at start: delete Avaris.ini.

lines: ## The patched script packages
{archive:patched-scripts} holds our patched GUI.u, UCGameplay.u, UCMenu.u and UCMutators.u:
mouse look, a keys menu with keyboard glyphs, your player name, extra maps, players three and four, the
wide-screen HUD, and fixes taken from Epic's own source. Extract it into the game folder too, keeping a
copy of the game's own four files; without them the game runs its shipped scripts unchanged. The Android
app reads them from the game folder.
## The patched script packages
This build has no patched script packages: its scripts differ from the newest release's, and only a game
folder can build them. Without them the game runs its shipped scripts unchanged.
## Making the game folder from your Xbox disc
{archive:cooker} holds the tool that makes the game folder from your Xbox disc (or Epic's
source tree). It needs Python 3.8 or newer and ffmpeg; its README.md has the steps.
## The level editor
{archive:unrealed-windows-x86} holds UnrealEd, the level editor (Windows, 32-bit), and
{archive:unrealed-bitmaps} its splash and button-bar bitmaps (Epic's files). Extract both into the
game folder after the windows-x86 archive and start UnrealEd.exe from System.
## The level editor
{archive:unrealed-windows-x86} holds UnrealEd, the level editor (Windows, 32-bit). This build has no
editor bitmaps (Epic's splash and button-bar files): extract the newest release's UnrealEd archive into
the game folder first, then the windows-x86 archive and this one, and start UnrealEd.exe from System.
